description: National award for children with outstanding achievements.
Eligible: Children below 18 years with exceptional achievements in innovation, scholastic, sports, arts, culture, social service, or bravery.
Provides award certificate, medal, and cash prize.
Recognizes and encourages child talent.
documents_required: Proof of achievement (certificates, awards, news clippings)
channel_partner_name: District Education Office + NCERT, National Portal
maximum_benefit: National award with certificate, medal, and cash prize (amount varies by category)

description: Pension scheme for unorganised sector workers.
Eligible: Unorganised sector workers, age 18–40 years, monthly income below ₹15,000.
Provides minimum assured pension of ₹3,000 per month after age 60.
Worker contributes small amount monthly; government provides matching contribution.
documents_required: Self-declaration of eligibility (unorganised worker, income below ₹15,000)
maximum_benefit: Minimum assured pension of ₹3,000 per month after age 60

description: Maternity benefit scheme for pregnant women and lactating mothers.
Eligible: Pregnant women and lactating mothers (first living child), age 19+ years.
Provides ₹5,000 in three instalments during pregnancy and after childbirth.
Aim: improve health and nutrition for mother and child.
documents_required: Mother and Child Protection Card (MCP Card)
maximum_benefit: ₹5,000 in three instalments

description: Affordable generic medicines through Jan Aushadhi Kendras.
Eligible: All Indian citizens, no restrictions.
Provides quality generic medicines at 50–90% lower prices than branded medicines.
Implemented through Jan Aushadhi Kendras across India.
maximum_benefit: Access to quality generic medicines at 50–90% lower prices

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana - Entrepreneur Scheme
description: Scheme for entrepreneurs to open Jan Aushadhi Kendras.
Eligible: Indian citizens, age 18+ years, pharmacist or graduate/postgraduate in science/life sciences.
Provides incentive for setting up Jan Aushadhi Kendra.
Priority to women, SC/ST, persons with disabilities.
documents_required: Pharmacy degree certificate or science degree certificate
channel_partner_name: Bureau of Pharma PSUs of India (BPPI) Office + CSC centre
maximum_benefit: Incentive for setting up Jan Aushadhi Kendra (up to ₹5–10 lakh)

description: Integrated development of SC-majority villages.
Eligible: Villages with >50% SC population.
Provides infrastructure development (roads, water, sanitation, education, health).
Implemented through state governments.
documents_required: Proof of residence in SC-majority village
maximum_benefit: Infrastructure development (roads, water, sanitation, education, health facilities)

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojana (PM-AJAY)
description: Development scheme for SC communities.
Eligible: SC communities, priority to aspirational districts and SC sub-plans.
Provides infrastructure development, skill training, and livelihood support.
Implemented through state governments.
channel_partner_name: Gram Panchayat Office + District Social Welfare Office
maximum_benefit: Infrastructure development + skill training + livelihood support

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
description: Free foodgrain distribution to BPL families.
Eligible: BPL families with ration cards (Antyodaya, Priority Household).
Provides 5 kg free foodgrain per person per month.
Aim: ensure food security during crises.
channel_partner_name: Fair Price Shop (PDS) + Gram Panchayat Office
maximum_benefit: 5 kg free foodgrain per person per month

description: Subsidized foodgrain distribution through Public Distribution System.
Eligible: BPL and AAY families with ration cards.
Provides rice at ₹3/kg, wheat at ₹2/kg, coarse grains at ₹1/kg.
Implemented through Fair Price Shops across India.
channel_partner_name: Fair Price Shop (PDS) + Gram Panchayat Office
maximum_benefit: Subsidized foodgrain (rice ₹3/kg, wheat ₹2/kg, coarse grains ₹1/kg)

description: Additional LPG connections for BPL and vulnerable families.
Eligible: Adult women from BPL households, SC/ST, forest dwellers, tea garden workers, no existing LPG connection.
Provides deposit-free LPG connection with subsidy.
Priority to SC/ST, rural households.
documents_required: BPL ration card or SECC proof
maximum_benefit: Free LPG connection (worth ₹3,200) + ongoing LPG subsidy

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G) Phase II
description: Financial assistance for pucca house construction in rural areas.
Eligible: Rural households living in kutcha/dilapidated houses, prioritised for SC/ST, minorities, women-headed households.
Benefit: ₹1.20 lakh (plain areas) or ₹1.30 lakh (hilly/difficult areas) in instalments.
Selection based on SECC 2011 data.
documents_required: BPL ration card or SECC-listed proof
Filled application form at Gram Panchayat
channel_partner_name: Gram Panchayat Office, Village – Khajuraho, District – Chhatarpur, Madhya Pradesh
maximum_benefit: ₹1.20 lakh (plain) or ₹1.30 lakh (hilly) for house construction

description: Rural road connectivity scheme.
Eligible: Unconnected habitations with population >100 (plain areas) or >50 (hilly/tribal areas).
Provides all-weather road connectivity.
Implemented through state governments.
documents_required: Proof of residence in unconnected habitation
channel_partner_name: Gram Panchayat Office + District Rural Development Agency
maximum_benefit: All-weather road connectivity to unconnected habitations

description: Irrigation scheme for farmers.
Eligible: Farmers with cultivable land.
Provides micro-irrigation, drip/sprinkler systems, and water conservation structures.
Subsidy up to 55–75% depending on category and area.
channel_partner_name: Gram Panchayat Office + District Agriculture Office
maximum_benefit: Micro-irrigation systems with 55–75% subsidy

description: Scheme for fisheries sector development.
Eligible: Fishers, fish farmers, fish workers, fish vendors, women, SC/ST.
Provides financial assistance for fish farming, infrastructure, value chain development.
Subsidy up to 40–60% depending on category.
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: Financial assistance up to ₹10–20 lakh with 40–60% subsidy

description: Pension scheme for small and marginal farmers.
Eligible: Small and marginal farmers (landholding up to 2 hectares), age 18–40 years.
Provides minimum assured pension of ₹3,000 per month after age 60.
Farmer contributes small amount monthly; government provides matching contribution.
channel_partner_name: Gram Panchayat Office + District Agriculture Office
maximum_benefit: Minimum assured pension of ₹3,000 per month after age 60

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Laghu Vyapari Maandhan Yojana
description: Pension scheme for small traders and shopkeepers.
Eligible: Small traders, shopkeepers, self-employed persons, age 18–40 years, annual turnover below ₹1.5 crore.
Provides minimum assured pension of ₹3,000 per month after age 60.
Subscriber contributes small amount monthly; government provides matching contribution.
documents_required: Self-declaration of eligibility (trader/shopkeeper, turnover below ₹1.5 crore)
maximum_benefit: Minimum assured pension of ₹3,000 per month after age 60

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jivan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
description: Life insurance scheme with ₹2 lakh cover for death due to any cause.
Eligible: Indian citizens, age 18–50 years, with bank account.
Annual premium: ₹436 (auto-debited from bank account).
Coverage continues till age 55 with annual renewal.
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: ₹2 lakh life insurance cover

description: Accident insurance scheme with ₹2 lakh cover for accidental death or permanent disability, ₹1 lakh for partial disability.
Eligible: Indian citizens, age 18–70 years, with bank account.
Annual premium: ₹20 (auto-debited from bank account).
Coverage continues till age 70 with annual renewal.
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: ₹2 lakh for accidental death/permanent disability, ₹1 lakh for partial disability

description: Pension scheme for senior citizens.
Eligible: Indian citizens, age 60+ years.
Provides assured return of 7.4% per annum, payable monthly for 10 years.
Maximum investment: ₹15 lakh per senior citizen.
maximum_benefit: Assured return of 7.4% per annum on investment up to ₹15 lakh

description: Savings scheme for senior citizens with attractive interest rate.
Eligible: Indian citizens, age 60+ years (55+ for retired defence personnel).
Provides quarterly interest payments at notified rate (currently ~8.2% p.a.).
Maximum investment: ₹30 lakh per individual.
documents_required: Retirement proof (if applicable for 55+ defence personnel)
maximum_benefit: Quarterly interest at ~8.2% p.a. on investment up to ₹30 lakh

description: Free comprehensive antenatal care for pregnant women.
Eligible: All pregnant women, especially from poor and vulnerable sections.
Provides free check-ups, tests, and consultations on 9th of every month.
Implemented through government health facilities.
documents_required: Mother and Child Protection Card (MCP Card)
maximum_benefit: Free comprehensive antenatal check-ups, tests, and consultations

description: Scheme for establishing AIIMS-like institutions and upgrading government medical colleges.
Eligible: Patients seeking tertiary healthcare.
Provides affordable quality healthcare through new AIIMS and upgraded medical colleges.
Implemented through Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.
documents_required: Referral letter from lower health facility
maximum_benefit: Affordable quality tertiary healthcare

description: Free dialysis services for poor patients.
Eligible: BPL patients with kidney failure.
Provides free dialysis sessions at empanelled hospitals.
Implemented through National Health Mission.
documents_required: BPL ration card or income certificate
maximum_benefit: Free dialysis sessions (cost covered by government)

description: Affordable generic medicines through Jan Aushadhi Kendras.
Eligible: All Indian citizens, no restrictions.
Provides quality generic medicines at 50–90% lower prices than branded medicines.
Implemented through Jan Aushadhi Kendras across India.
maximum_benefit: Access to quality generic medicines at 50–90% lower prices

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY) - Ayushman Bharat
description: Health insurance scheme providing coverage up to ₹5 lakh per family per year.
Eligible: BPL families and specific occupational categories (SECC 2011 data).
Covers secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
Cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals across India.
documents_required: Aadhaar card of all family members
maximum_benefit: Health insurance coverage up to ₹5 lakh per family per year
